items.title: Ledger wallet tampering suspected after reports of crypto thefts

items.lede: Ledger has confirmed that some of its devices distributed through Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis were compromised with a hardware implant that drained users' cryptocurrency wallets. [...]
items.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts

items.lede: Store-bought Ledger hardware crypto wallets in Southeast Asia and Europe compromised in ongoing supply chain attack — $71 million and counting thanks to implanted eSIM and LTE modules
items.title: Store-bought hardware crypto wallets had secret chips installed that enabled stealing crypto recovery phrases

items.lede: Ledger is reviewing chain-of-custody practices and anti-tamper protections after modified hardware wallets sold through a third party were allegedly fitted with LTE implants that captured recovery phrases and enabled $93 million in crypto theft.
items.title: After a $93 million crypto hardware-wallet supply chain attack, Ledger to review sales and anti-tamper policies
